Name: AbacusBio
Description:
AbacusBio are international leaders in the application of science and technology in agriculture, horticulture, and aquaculture. We combine science and business expertise to grow our clients’ revenue and profit.

Our consultants work globally on industry-leading initiatives across the primary food supply chain, with specific skill-sets in biological and data science, production system economics, strategy and investment, and technology. Their global reach gives the company a technical and strategic view of a wide range of challenges facing primary food production.

Name: Eurofins Australia New Zealand
Description:
AFFILIATED PAGES INCLUDE: Eurofins New Zealand, Eurofins Environment Testing - AUS/NZ, Eurofins BioPharma Testing ANZ.                                                                      
Eurofins is an international life sciences company, which provides a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries. The Group believes it is the world leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetics products testing and in agroscience CRO services. It is also one of the global independent market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, CDMO, advanced material sciences and for supporting clinical studies. In addition, Eurofins is one of the leading global emerging players in specialty clinical diagnostic testing. The Group objective is to provide its customers with high-quality services, accurate results on time and expert advice by its highly qualified staff.

In Australia/New Zealand, we currently focus on the following industries;
-	Environment Testing 
-	Agroscience Services and Testing
-	BioPharma Product Testing
-	Food and Water Testing

Name: HiRO - Harvest Integrated Research Organization - ANZ (formerly PharmaSols)
Description:
HiRO ANZ (formerly PharmaSols) is the longest established, best connected, privately-owned Clinical Research Organisation (CRO) in the Pacific region.
For over 25 years, we have successfully supported patient needs and delivered outstanding results for global Pharma, Biotechs and CROs across hundreds of studies.

Our team has international experience with large pharmaceutical, medical device and biotech organisations, with expertise across a wide variety of therapeutic areas.

Inspired by their contribution to improving health and wellbeing, our passionate team works with you to support and facilitate your clinical trials, delivering participant recruitment and retention targets, and quality data outcomes.

Our strong, trusted relationships with partners, clients, key opinion leaders, site staff, and investigators means we lead the way in:

Start-to-finish project management and clinical operations
Site selection and participant recruitment
Ethics committee and regulatory submissions
Data management and biostatistics
Quality assurance
Local sponsorship and third-party vendor management
Commercial regulatory consultancy
Flexible, responsive and innovative, we are based in Australia and New Zealand – the best place in the world to conduct clinical trials.

Talk to us about your next study.

Name: Pacific Edge Ltd
Description:
Pacific Edge Limited (NZX/ ASX: PEB) is a global cancer diagnostics company leading the way in the development and commercialization of bladder cancer diagnostic and prognostic tests for patients presenting with hematuria or surveillance of recurrent disease. Headquartered in Dunedin, New Zealand, the company provides its suite of Cxbladder tests globally through its wholly owned, and CLIA certified, laboratories in New Zealand and the USA.

Cxbladder is a suite of non-invasive genomic urine tests optimized for the risk stratification of urothelial cancer in patients presenting with microhematuria and those being monitored for recurrent disease. The tests help improve the overall patient experience, while prioritizing time and clinical resources to optimize practice workflow and improve efficiency.

Supported by over 20 years of research, Cxbladder’s evidence portfolio extends to more than 25 peer reviewed publications, and Cxbladder Triage is now included in the American Urological Association’s Microhematuria Guideline. To drive increased adoption and improved patient health outcomes, Cxbladder is the focal point of numerous ongoing and planned studies designed to generate further clinical utility evidence.

Cxbladder is available in the US, Australasia, and Israel and in markets throughout Asia and South America. In the US, the test has been used by over 5,000 urologists who have ordered more than 130,000 tests. In New Zealand, Cxbladder is accessible to around 70% of the population via public healthcare and all residents have the option of buying the test online.

Learn more at www.cxbladder.com

Name: Opo Bio
Description:
Next generation bio-based ingredients for cosmetic and medical applications.

By leveraging an advanced technology portfolio across synthetic biology and industrial biomanufacturing, we deliver high-performance biomaterials that outperform alternatives across, performance, sustainability and safety.

Name: Mushroom Material
Description:
With the global shift towards sustainability, there is a demand for eco friendly materials. We have developed a sustainable mushroom based material as an alternative to polystyrene styrofoam and cardboard packaging.
- Customizable to any shape, size and surface finish
- Stronger than concrete pound for pound
- Better thermal insulator than fiberglass
- Limitless sustainable supply
- Fire resistant, water proof, 100% compostable, odorless, mold resistant, non-toxic
 
In order to address global climate change, the European Union, 25 other countries and over 100 US cities will ban non recyclable packaging materials, including polystyrene Styrofoam by 2025.
 
Our mission is to eliminate non recyclable plastics from the environment by developing mushroom based packaging material. For more information visit our website or send us a message.

Name: humble bee bio
Description:
At Humble Bee Bio, we combine nature with modern technology to create high-value products supporting climate stability, biodiversity and beauty. 

For too long, the beauty industry has extracted from nature, driving environmental degradation and animal cruelty. With advances in biotechnology, we now create ethical, sustainable molecules inspired by nature's genome.

Our journey began with rare solitary bees, whose genomes we sequenced to uncover novel molecules, including one with a rare and potent property — elastin stimulation - soon to be available as a hero ingredient for formulation.

Revenue from our products will support indigenous-led organisations working to restore and protect biodiversity.

Creation as regeneration. That’s what we do at Humble Bee Bio.

Name: Engender Technologies Limited
Description:
Engender technology is a next-generation livestock gender-sorting technology.

Engender was formed to solve the high value problem of gender selection in the dairy industry.  Initially formed as a spin-out from University of Auckland, Engender's technology uses photonics to orient and sort livestock spermatozoa by gender at lower cost and lower impact than presently possible.

Name: MicroGEM
Description: MicroGEM is democratizing molecular biology by moving molecular techniques out of conventional, highly skilled laboratories to non-laboratory settings. The company’s innovative enzymatic approach to nucleic acid extraction provides the foundation for rapid sample preparation suitable for PCR analysis. Coupled with MicroGEM’s expertise in microfluidics and synthetic biology, the company is strongly positioned to create person-portable diagnostic devices, representing the next generation of point of need solutions to address global health concerns.

Name: Woolchemy
Description:
Woolchemy is a material technology company that makes high performance biobased materials made from wool.  

Woolchemy emerged as a result of a collective of women who were dissatisfied with personal care products that failed to cater to their specific requirements. With the collaboration of a marketer proficient in personal hygiene products and an engineer specialising in wool nonwovens and absorbent technology, the team at Woolchemy possesses a unique ability to grasp the discerning demands of modern consumers who value convenience, performance, and environmental sustainability.

Name: Winely
Description:
Winely is an AI-powered precision fermentation solution that optimises tradition, while deepening the connection between the winemaker and the wine by helping them unlock and understand the true depth of their vintages via real-time, deep learning-based data collection and analysis. Our technology produces wine whisperers, optimised artisans of their craft empowered by Cloud-based automation, artificial intelligence and IoT technologies. Leveraging the most universally accurate sensor on the market to deliver to-the-second data insights, Winely’s automation capabilities free up time, space, costs and manpower associated with the rote tasks of winemaking, thereby allowing vintners to return to their creativity while optimizing the wine they’ve already created. Our deep AI technology automatically and continuously generates live ferment data that can be accessed at any point from any mobile device, thereby drastically reducing the need for dangerous manual sampling, clarifying tank interventions and offering unmatched insights to winemakers. Winely is an Exocule company that shares its commitment to a cleaner future.

For some wineries, it takes 36 hours to produce data about actions that should have been taken 36 hours ago. Winely’s award-winning technology saves winemakers time, labor, manpower and money, while increasing safety and compliance by removing the need to manually retrieve and run lab samples during fermentation. This alone provides customers immediate ROI, with proven cost savings to the tune of $100,000 per year for savings on interventions and $450,000 per vintage for savings on labour. After four years of intensive research and development led by 155 bioscientists and researchers at the, Winely’s fifth-generation IoT sensors measure the most critical data sets for any given vintage while providing accurate data visualisation and predictive machine learning algorithms, thereby enabling the winemaker to make quick and easy decisions on interventions an

Name: Amaroq Therapeutics
Description:
Amaroq Therapeutics is a New Zealand-based biotechnology company focused on developing a new class of therapeutics that target lncRNA in cancer. 

Long non-coding RNAs are a relatively recently discovered class of molecules often referred to as “dark matter” of the human genome. These naturally occurring molecules do not code for proteins but fulfill important regulatory functions in the cell that could be exploited as a new therapeutic approach for multiple indications. Amaroq’s research team has discovered lncRNA molecules that are highly expressed in cancer cells, and once removed, cancer cell growth slows. Amaroq Therapeutics is developing innovative therapeutics to target lncRNAs for cancer treatment.

Amaroq Therapeutics is funded by the Medical Research Commercialisation Fund, managed by life science venture capital firm Brandon Capital Partners, Otago Innovation Ltd, University of Otago, Cure Kids, and NZ Innovation Booster. The Company has been spun out of research from the University of Otago in Dunedin, New Zealand.

Name: HELICO
Description:
At Helico, our goal is to unlock the innate ability of plants to become factories for medicinal compounds. Employing innovative research in computational biology and plant physiology, we've packed advanced manufacturing facilities in seeds to produce the world's most needed medicines.

Helico is designing computational and plant models to bring our partners’ targets through a successful manufacturing process. We provide expertise and services in the following areas:

- Design of molecular production
- Computational biology and bioinformatic
- Plant physiology improvements
- Contract manufacturing of biologics

Name: Wool Source
Description:
As consumer demand increases for sustainable, ethically made products that
perform, Wool Source has developed a range of transformational natural materials to help our customers meet this need.

Wool Source delivers a range of natural wool-based particles, powders and pigments for use as ingredients in a variety of products ranging from printing to personal care.

Investment in cutting-edge science and technology, developed in partnership with New Zealand’s wool growers, supply chain participants, Wool Research Organisation of New Zealand and the New Zealand Government over the last seven years, has enabled our Wool Industry Research team to revolutionise use of nature’s performance fibre.

The patent-protected secret within the Wool Source technology is the ability to transform wool’s physical form while maintaining its key natural performance benefits, enabling the use of wool in a variety of new applications.

All Wool Source products are created from New Zealand wool fibre that is traceable, sustainable and renewable. All of our suppliers are independently certified to ensure the highest standards of animal welfare, environmental sustainability, and responsible land management.

Talk to us to find out more.

Name: Banksia Scientific Company
Description:
Since our humble beginnings in 1980, Banksia Scientific has been a supplier to the scientific and medical community across Australia, New Zealand and the Pacific Islands. 

In 2004 we relocated to larger more efficient premises in Auckland and Brisbane and in 2005 we opened up our Sydney office which enabled us to provide our customers with a far more effective service further enhancing our reputation that other suppliers aspire to.

A true measure of any sales organisations success is the percentage of repeat orders received and recommendations passed on and we are proud to declare an exceptionally high level of such success in this area. We aim to please and will strive to supply you with the products that you require at a sensible price, a decent level of quality and within a suitable time frame.

We look forward to working with our existing customers and partners and expanding our customer base throughout the territories and providing them with the same high level of service and friendly help that our customers have become accustomed to.

We would like to thank all our previous customers for your support over the past 28 years and we look forward to an exciting future with many new ventures. Please feel free to contact any of our staff to see how we can help you come to a better result for your laboratory.

Banksia Scientific’s Head Office is in Bulimba, Queensland, Australia and incorporates our Australian based sales team, accounts department, orders department (both export and local) and a warehouse where most of our supplies are shipped from. The senior management is also based here with hands-on involvement in all areas of the company.

Our New Zealand office is based in Auckland and incorporates our New Zealand based sales team along with the warehouse and logistics for the National orders. All stock for our New Zealand customers is held in Auckland to allow for an overnight delivery to all areas.

Name: Koru Biotech
Description:
Koru BioTech is a New Zealand biotechnology company building on breakthrough research into infection biology to develop new approaches to diagnostics, prevention, and immune protection.

Our work began with research into infectious diseases in dairy cattle, where we identified three important scientific insights:
•	A measurable biomarker linked to Gram-negative infections
•	A non antibiotic approach to treat Gram negative pathogens
•	A naturally occurring immune complex that helps protect newborns from disease.

As our research has progressed, so has our understanding of where it can lead. Today, Koru is building on this foundation to explore new approaches across a wider range of infectious disease settings.

With peer-reviewed research, protected intellectual property, and ongoing development work, the company is focused on translating scientific insight into practical tools that improve outcomes while supporting more responsible use of antibiotics.

Koru works at the intersection of infection biology, diagnostics, and prevention, with potential relevance across animal health, agriculture, and broader One Health contexts.

We aim to turn deeper understanding of infection biology into tools that improve outcomes and reduce reliance on broad antibiotic use.

Name: Ampersand Technologies
Description:
Ampersand Technologies is developing custom, precision genetic tests to enable evidence-based decision-making in horticulture, agriculture, biosecurity, and environmental monitoring.

The technology has emerged as a challenger to PCR in the molecular diagnostics space and is already being used for point-of-need human medical diagnostics. Ampersand’s objective is to bring this technology to sectors that stand to benefit from using molecular diagnostics at the point-of-need, and to build a connected solution, providing a clear pathway to implementation for end users.

Ampersand Technologies officially launched in August 2021. The start-up, which is being led by Dr. Richard Winkworth, received co-investment from Matū, a venture capital fund focused on early-stage science and technology, and Massey Ventures, the company responsible for commercialising innovative research at Massey University.

Name: Nextgen Bioinformatic Services Ltd
Description: We run a small (but growing) bioinformatics company based in Palmerston North New Zealand. Our aim is to provide high quality bioinformatic services at the best possible price. Be sure to check out our website (www.ngbs.co.nz) for a full description of our services.

Name: Bioforce Limited
Description:
Bioforce rears and sells biological control agents for the control of plant pests and diseases. At Bioforce we produce and sell multiple beneficial organisms, organisms that have the ability to suppress pest populations below levels that necessitate the use of chemical controls.

We strongly believe that it is in everyone’s interest to reduce the quantity of chemical pesticides applied to horticultural crops; be that to reduce the production costs of the grower, to prevent pesticide resistance development in the pest population, to improve the health and working environment of horticultural workers, protect the natural environment, and to provide the consumer with the freshest, tastiest and healthiest produce and ornamental plants possible.

Bioforce advocates for the sustainable management of horticultural crops, but recognise that to do that, growers must have access to effective pest management tools. We endeavour to provide growers with those tools necessary to achieve the sustainable production of horticultural crops.

Medicinal cannabis has been breaking barriers around the world for over 20 years, and now, right here in New Zealand Organic Genetics, is offering YOU the opportunity to be a part of this global industry and join us on our mission to provide the people of Aotearoa the highest and purest form of premium craft cannabis products.

Welcome to the future of wellness New Zealand, we invite you to join us!

Name: Bontia Bio
Description:
Bontia Bio is a synthetic biology company focused on developing natural parasiticides for the animal health and crop protection. 

The company was founded on technology developed at the Ferrier Research Institute, hosted at Victoria University of Wellington, New Zealand.

Name: Kaha Sciences
Description:
Kaha Sciences sets the new standard in quality and power for implantable, wireless telemetry in rats and mice. The best telemetry option for research scientists, record continuous data from freely moving animals across extended periods with accuracy, reliability and sensitivity.

Kaha telemeters can record true high-fidelity signals such as ventricular and arterial pressures, sympathetic nerve activity (SNA), biopotentials (e.g. ECG, EMG & EEG), and tissue oxygen. The patented wireless power technology along with a Mikro-TipTM catheter (Millar Inc.) containing the solid-state sensor at the catheter tip, was the first product of its type. This provides customers with the ability and confidence to measure long-term, highly accurate and sensitive recordings from intracardiac through to intracranial pressures. The product range has grown to include specific and unique devices such as tissue oxygen and SNA/Pressure telemeters.

Kaha Sciences is a brand of ADInstruments NZ Ltd. ADInstruments gives researchers access to a trusted global sales and support network with over 30 year of industry experience.

Name: Ruakura Technologies Limited
Description:
Our purpose at RuaTech is to take big ideas and use robust science to develop these ideas into meaningful products to improve people’s lives. We do this by having a team of highly skilled individuals who work collaboratively to seek innovation.

Our first big idea harnesses nature’s method of early immune protection. Antibody transfer through milk is a critical part of our own immune development, and RuaTech is using this principle to establish an immune milk platform for production of natural milk products with bioactivity against human pathogens. We envision a world where dairy herd immunity can contribute to consumer protection through effective, readily available products for everyone.

We are currently developing an alternative technology for protection against COVID 19 infection based on immune milk.

Name: Regen Cellular
Description:
We are New Zealand’s most advanced stem cell company specialising in the treatment of osteoarthritis and sports injuries.

We are the only clinic to operate its own laboratory allowing us to grow a patient’s own cells to numbers high enough for cartilage to regenerate. This treatment is called Pure Expanded Stem Cell (PESC) therapy.

Our treatments use our patient’s own stem cells derived from fat, as well as platelet-rich plasma (PRP) to boost the body's own healing abilities and promote tissue rejuvenation. Our proprietary PESC protocol offers the highest concentration of stem cells available in any treatment today.

Description: New Zealand based Plant Tissue Culture Laboratory and Plant Science Research Facility.  Established in 1981.  Accredited Quarantine Facility for plant export and imports with greenhouse and laboratory capabilities.

Name: Hi-Aspect Limited
Description:
Hi-Aspect makes protein fibrils for use in the life sciences. The core technology is the
production of a high surface area, insoluble protein material with applications in skincare, and
wound healing. The fibril scaffold can bind, stabilize and release active ingredients in a
controllable manner while holding them close to the site of action.

The scaffold material forms a gel, therefore providing functional properties in a formulation
without the need for emulsifiers and other additives. The fibrils maintain their functional
properties while in use but degrade slowly so they are not environmentally persistent.

The proprietary production process does not require harsh conditions or toxic chemical agents
that would leave residues, and the fibrils formed mimic materials found in nature. The fibril
scaffold can also be formulated as sheets with and without composite materials, and can be
made from a variety of protein sources to suit the final application.

Name: Mod NZ
Description:
MOD is a biotech organisation run by students from the University of Auckland.

In the lab, we are currently developing plants with improved fertiliser uptake and metabolism. This has the potential to reduce pollution from our agriculture industry, reduce fertiliser costs for farmers and growers, and increase pasture growth rates/yields.

We are on track to have a proof of concept plant by the end of 2018, and have detailed plans to improve the plant further during 2019. We have built our business case and we are entering our project in the international biotechnology competition, iGEM.

MOD is also a multi-disciplinary advocate. We provide science students with a mix of real lab and commercial experience. When we're not in the lab, we're involved with community engagement, presentations and biotech advocacy initiatives.
